business.what_it_does: Help Scout is a customer communication platform that brings email, SMS, social, chat, and voice into one shared Inbox, with an AI agent (Scout) that resolves support requests and a copilot that drafts replies for human agents.
business.business_model: subscription, priced per user per month, with paid add-ons for extra Inboxes and Docs sites

facts.statement: Our AI agent, Scout, resolves 73% of the requests it receives on average.

provenance.quote: What began with 36 conversations handled in the first week has now grown to nearly 300 per week by August. Their deflection rate, which Luke once hoped might reach 10%, has consistently climbed past that mark, peaking at 15.46%

facts.statement: At King Arthur Flour, AI Drafts cut email response times by about a third, saving roughly 2.5 FTEs annually.

provenance.quote: AI Drafts helped us cut email response times by about a third, saving us the equivalent of roughly 2.5 FTEs annually. It helps our team move faster while keeping a human in the loop.

facts.statement: The Free plan is limited to just 1 Inbox and 1 Docs site, while the Standard plan (and above) lists 'Multiple Inboxes' and 'Multiple knowledge bases' as included features — the two sources describe different entitlements for different tiers, not a single unlimited claim.

facts.statement: Additional Inboxes beyond the number included in a plan cost $10/month (paid annually) or $12/month; additional Docs sites cost $20/month (paid annually) or $24/month.

provenance.quote: Yes — additional Inboxes beyond the number included in your plan are available for $10 per month when paid annually (or $12 per month). Additional Docs sites are available for $20 per month when paid annually (or $24 per month).

$45per user/mo ... Everything in Standard and... Advanced workflows, Two advanced SLA policies, Secure customer portal, Unlimited AI Drafts, Round robin routing, Salesforce, Jira, and HubSpot, Internal teams

entries.claim: The New Wheel is a bike shop founded in San Francisco by co-founders Brett Thurber and Karen Wiener, focused on the e-bike experience.
entries.verbatim: Founded in San Francisco with a vision of transforming the e-bike experience, The New Wheel sets out to bring exceptional care to a traditionally transactional industry. For co-founders Brett Thurber and Karen Wiener, that meant treating every customer like a long-term partner, not a one-time buyer, and building a team culture rooted in fairness, transparency, and human connection.

entries.claim: The New Wheel became a Help Scout customer in 2016.
entries.verbatim: The New Wheel became a Help Scout customer in 2016.

entries.claim: The New Wheel has 24 teammates and a single phone number ringing across all locations, with everyone having access to the support queue.
entries.verbatim: With 24 teammates and a single phone number ringing across all locations, anyone might be the one helping a customer.

entries.claim: Help Scout's shared inbox gives all teammates access to the queue, letting them see customer context, collaborate behind the scenes, and follow conversations to resolution.
entries.verbatim: Help Scout’s shared inbox makes that easy. All teammates have access to the queue and can see customer context, collaborate behind the scenes, and follow conversations to resolution.

entries.claim: The New Wheel now manages four inboxes across teams and locations, runs two Beacons on their site, and maintains a Docs knowledge base for self-service.
entries.verbatim: They now manage four inboxes across teams and locations, run two Beacons on their site, and maintain a rich Docs knowledge base for self-service.

entries.claim: AI Answers handles common customer questions instantly, and workflow automations help the team stay organized and responsive.
entries.verbatim: AI Answers handles common questions instantly, while workflow automations help their team stay organized and responsive.

entries.claim: The New Wheel uses Help Scout for more than customer interactions, including accounting, purchasing management, and warranty management, via a centralized inbox everyone can collaborate on.
entries.verbatim: We use Help Scout for more than just our customer interactions. We also use it for accounting, purchasing management, and warranty management. It allows us to have a centralized inbox that everyone can collaborate on.

entries.verbatim: We’re not looking to replace support teams with AI, but if we can let AI answer the simple questions, it frees us up to create ‘wow moments’ for customers.

entries.claim: Luke evaluated other AI vendors — Zoom, Maven, and Intercom — and found those bolt-on tools required major process changes, whereas AI Answers lives inside Help Scout where the team already works.
entries.verbatim: After weighing various AI vendors like Zoom, Maven, and Intercom, Luke found those bolt-on tools required major process changes. AI Answers stood out because it lives where the team already works, in Help Scout.

context.subject: Help Scout AI Answers - Suggested Improvements

voice.tone: Warm and mission-driven but plainspoken; sells capability through customer outcomes rather than hype, with light humor in headlines
voice.rhythm: Short declarative sentences mixed with one longer explanatory sentence per paragraph; frequent one-line paragraphs used as emphasis or transition
voice.person: We (the company); product features are personified with names like Scout, Copilot, Signal, Envoy
exemplars: People should never be reduced to transactions and ticket numbers, and businesses shouldn’t have to compromise the customer experience as they scale.
Ownership is key to our collective success. We consider the impact on our team and our community before we act, and believe that trust and integrity are non-negotiable.

Working across teams and channels doesn’t have to be messy. Inbox brings email, SMS, social, chat, and voice into one clean space. Assignments happen automatically. Context carries through every handoff. And workflows keep it all organized.
Closing out conversations is just the beginning. Signal shows you the story behind them, so you can get ahead of emerging issues, save drifting accounts, and see what basic reporting misses.

Envoy combines frontier models with insights learned from 3+ billion conversations. The result? Your own powerful AI agent, Scout, that delivers accurate answers, smooth escalations, and judgment that reflects your own.

segments.name: Lean support team lead at a scaling software company
segments.situation: A small customer support team facing rising conversation volume and a coverage gap, needing to extend capacity without new headcount while keeping the team's own voice in replies.

situation_provenance.quote: At the start of 2025, one of Luke's top team members moved into a product role, creating a coverage gap just as volume was rising.

segments.job_to_be_done: Let AI handle repetitive, simple questions so the human team can focus on high-value, 'wow moment' interactions, without adopting a disruptive new tool.
segments.trigger: Loss of a team member combined with rising conversation volume

pains.statement: Other AI vendors required major process changes to adopt.

provenance.quote: After weighing various AI vendors like Zoom, Maven, and Intercom, Luke found those bolt-on tools required major process changes.

segments.name: Small business owner who sells on relationship, not transactions
segments.situation: A founder-led retail/service business (e.g. a bike shop) that wants every customer interaction to feel personal and trust-building rather than ticketed.

situation_provenance.quote: We wanted every customer to feel truly valued — like they were building a relationship, not just getting a product.

segments.job_to_be_done: Run support as plain conversations with real people, with the tool staying invisible in the background.
segments.trigger: Scaling a hands-on, relationship-based service business beyond what founders can personally answer

pains.statement: They wanted a tool with no portals and no ticket numbers, just clear, personal conversations.

provenance.quote: They were looking for a support tool that felt invisible — no portals, no ticket numbers, just clear, personal conversations with real people that build trust over time.

objections.objection: AI support tools require disruptive process changes to adopt.
objections.answer: AI Answers lives where the team already works, in Help Scout, and didn't require a big rollout or risky transition.

provenance.quote: AI Answers stood out because it lives where the team already works, in Help Scout.

objections.objection: Support software feels transactional — tickets and portals instead of real conversations.
objections.answer: Customers describe Help Scout as feeling like talking to a person, not using software.

provenance.quote: Help Scout doesn't feel like software. It feels like talking to someone who's genuinely here to help.
